items.title: Adobe acquires Topaz Labs, folding leading AI upscaling/restoration tools into Creative Cloud
items.excerpt: Adobe signed a definitive agreement to acquire Texas-based Topaz Labs, whose AI tools cover upscaling, sharpening, stabilization, frame interpolation, noise removal and footage restoration (Topaz Video, Gigapixel, Astra, Bloom). Adobe plans to bring the enhancement models into Firefly, Firefly Services and Creative Cloud, with Topaz's on-device Neurostream tech.
items.why: A concrete AI film-toolchain shift: the de-facto AI upscaling/restoration stack used across post gets folded into the dominant creative suite — reshaping the roadmap/licensing for a tool film finishers and restorers rely on. Parallels the already-published Boris FX/iZotope card but is a distinct, larger deal. Byline-date precision (Jun 26); RedShark chosen over the Jun 25 nofilmschool version (which is right at the cutoff). Also on 80.lv (Jun 26) and Variety (paywalled) if a swap is needed.

items.title: Topaz Video — In-Depth Review: testing the Starlight and Astra AI enhancement models
items.excerpt: Nick Lear puts Topaz Video's AI enhancement through four test cases from 320x240 footage to text-heavy graphics, finding Starlight and Astra strongest on hard restoration tasks and beating open-source Video2X/ComfyUI, while noting Topaz's subscription-only shift and the pending Adobe acquisition.
items.why: Hands-on craft evidence of how far AI upscaling/restoration has come for real film post workflows, plus the licensing/business context (subscription + Adobe deal). NOTE: same company/tech as #adobe-acquires-topaz-labs — treat as one Topaz cluster; pick at most one. Byline-date precision (Jul 8).

items.title: Color Mode in Premiere (beta): a zone-based color-grading overhaul, not lift/gamma/gain
items.excerpt: A deep dive into Premiere's new beta Color Mode, which replaces the traditional lift/gamma/gain model with a zone-based system built for log footage, wide-gamut media and HDR — Adobe's biggest color-grading rethink in the NLE in a decade.
items.why: A film color/finishing workflow shift inside the dominant editor. LOWER PRIORITY / WEAK AI HOOK: Color Mode itself is a UI/tonal-model change rather than a generative-AI feature, so it may fail a strict design-x-AI test — included as pool depth and flagged for the curator to drop if the final set needs a cleaner AI throughline. Byline-date precision (Jul 6).
